Backend for the OpenCoDE Catalogue Badges - Checking open-source repositories for active maintenance, security best practices and reuse

Usage:
  badge-api [command]

Available Commands:
  attest      Short...
  check       ...
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command
  serve       Start the badge-api server.

Flags:
  -h, --help               help for badge-api
  -l, --log-level string   Set the log level. Options are: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
  -t, --toggle             Help message for toggle

Use "badge-api [command] --help" for more information about a command.
exit=0
=== check help ===
...

Usage:
  badge-api check [flags]

Flags:
      --all-repositories string   Run checks against all repositories in the specified git base URL (example: https://gitlab.opencode.de)
  -h, --help                      help for check
      --output string             Stores sarif report in file (only when using --repository)
      --repository string         Run checks against a specific repository. Required if --all-repositories is not set

Global Flags:
  -l, --log-level string   Set the log level. Options are: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
=== docker ===
docker daemon OK

observation.command: cd /workspace && ./badge-api --help 2>&1 | head -40; echo "exit=$?"; echo "=== check help ==="; ./badge-api check --help 2>&1 | head -20; echo "=== docker ==="; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "docker daemon OK" || echo "docker daemon NOT available"
